notes: Left street printed only 'STREET' in the upper part; named TURRILL below Hoffner and assumed the same straight street (x 115-140) the whole height. Middle street (x 842-860) printed only 'STREET' above Blue Rock and APPLE below Hoffner; assumed one street called Apple Street. Chase, Knowlton, Palm, Blue Rock and Hoffner names are printed in the street; Chase 'Avenue', Blue Rock and Hoffner suffix not printed in the strip (Street assumed). '?' is the diagonal strip with a 12 inch sewer between the Vandalia tracks and block 28, from Apple Street north-east past Gulow; it may be railroad right of way rather than a street. Gulow Street runs from that strip south to Hoffner. A 20 ft unnamed alley runs diagonally across block 34 (about 980,7000 to 1250,6300) and a 10 ft alley at x about 1760 north of block 33; not picked. Hamilton crosses Knowlton and Palm east of x 1860 (not picked). Turrill/Knowlton/Palm/Blue Rock recorded as T because the west side is the plate edge.
